description: Reference mission: sourced launch brief from library + web.
request: Draft a launch brief for Tidewater, a planning app for small creative studios, for its March public beta.

library.title: Tidewater positioning notes (sample)
library.body: Tidewater is a calm planning app for small creative studios. It turns client briefs into a shared weekly plan. Launch: March public beta. Pricing is not decided.

library.title: Beta interview summary (sample)
library.body: Six studio leads interviewed. Five said weekly planning takes more than two hours. Four find general project tools too heavy.
